text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Organisasi Antarabangsa (Keistimewaan dan Kekebalan) (Persekutuan

Badminton Dunia) 2018.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna

yang lain—

"BWF" ertinya Persekutuan Badminton Dunia;

"Pegawai" ertinya pegawai, yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual, bagi Persekutuan

Badminton Dunia, bagi tujuan Pejabat;

"Pejabat" ertinya Ibu Pejabat BWF di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, untuk

melaksanakan fungsinya.

Ketidakpakaian

3. Peraturan-Peraturan ini tidak terpakai bagi seseorang Pegawai yang merupakan

warganegara dan penduduk tetap Malaysia termasuk pegawai tempatan dan ditugaskan

mengikut kadar jam.

Pengisytiharan BWF sebagai organisasi antarabangsa

4. BWF diisytiharkan menjadi suatu organisasi antarabangsa yang baginya

seksyen 4 Akta terpakai.

Keperibadian juridikal

5. BWF hendaklah mempunyai keperibadian juridikal dan hendaklah mempunyai

keupayaan—

(a) untuk membuat kontrak;

(b) untuk memperoleh dan melupuskan harta alih dan harta tak alih; dan

(c) untuk memulakan dan menjadi pihak kepada prosiding

undang-undang.

Keistimewaan BWF

6. (1) BWF hendaklah mempunyai keistimewaan yang dinyatakan dalam

perenggan 5, 6 dan 7 Jadual Pertama kepada Akta.

(2) BWF hendaklah bekerjasama pada setiap masa dan hendaklah

memastikan Pegawainya bekerjasama pada setiap masa dengan pihak berkuasa

Kerajaan Malaysia bagi melaksanakan pentadbiran keadilan sewajarnya, menjamin

pematuhan undang-undang domestik dan mencegah berlakunya apa-apa salah guna

keistimewaan yang diperuntukkan di bawah peraturan 6 dan 7.

Keistimewaan Pegawai

7. Seorang Pegawai hendaklah mempunyai keistimewaan yang dinyatakan dalam

perenggan 2 dan 7 Bahagian I Jadual Keempat kepada Akta.

JADUAL

PEGAWAI PERSEKUTUAN BADMINTON DUNIA

[Peraturan 2]

1. Presiden

2. Setiausaha Agung

3. Pengarah Operasi

4. Pengarah Komersial dan Komunikasi

5. Pengarah Pembangunan

6. Pengurus Komunikasi

7. Pengurus Pembangunan

8. Pengurus Acara Teknikal

9. Pengurus Pemasaran

10. Pengurus Integriti dan Badminton-Para

11. Pengurus Kejohanan Siri

12. Pengurus Undang-Undang

13. Pegawai Komunikasi

14. Pegawai Acara

Dibuat 12 Disember 2018

[KBS.S.BA.2-27/1; SR(050)RCSCD(S)735 Jld 3; PN(PU2)507/IV]

DATO' SAIFUDDIN BIN ABDULLAH

INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS (PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES) ACT 1992

INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS (PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES)

(THE BADMINTON WORLD FEDERATION) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsections 3(1) and 4(1) and section 11 of the

International Organizations (Privileges and Immunities) Act 1992 [Act 485], the Minister,

with the concurrence of the Minister of Finance, makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the International Organizations (Privileges

and Immunities) (The Badminton World Federation) Regulations 2018.

Interpretation

2. In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—

"BWF" means Badminton World Federation;

"Officer" means the officer, as specified in the Schedule, of the Badminton World

Federation, for the purpose of the Office;

"Office" means the BWF Headquarters in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, to perform

its functions.

Non-application

3. These regulations shall not apply to an Officer who is a citizen and a permanent

resident of Malaysia including an officer who is engaged locally and assigned to an

hourly rate.

Declaration of BWF to be an international organization

4. BWF is declared to be an international organization to which section 4 of the

Act applies.

Juridical personality

5. BWF shall have juridical personality and shall have the capacity—

(a) to enter into contracts;

(b) to acquire and dispose of movable and immovable property; and

(c) to institute and be a party to legal proceedings.

Privileges of BWF

6. (1) BWF shall have the privileges specified in paragraphs 5, 6 and 7 of the First

Schedule to the Act.

(2) BWF shall co-operate at all times and shall procure that its Officer

co-operate at all times with the appropriate authority of the Government of Malaysia to

facilitate the proper administration of justice, to secure the observance of domestic

legislation and to prevent the occurrence of any abuses in connection with the privileges

accorded under regulations 6 and 7.

Privileges of Officer

7. An Officer shall have the privileges specified in paragraphs 2 and 7 of Part I of the

Fourth Schedule to the Act.

SCHEDULE

OFFICER OF THE BADMINTON WORLD FEDERATION

[Regulation 2]

1. President

2. Secretary General

3. Director of Operation

4. Commercial and Communication Director

5. Development Director

6. Communications Manager

7. Development Manager

8. Technical Events Manager

9. Marketing Manager

10. Integrity and Para-Badminton Manager

11. Tournament Series Manager

12. Legal Manager

13. Communications Officer

14. Events Officer

Made 12 December 2018
